neighbours.label: the second part of an agent compound: '-made', 'made' in manmade, 'posed' in '-imposed' (government-imposed, man-made, self-imposed), firing on that piece; plain adjectives and the verb ' made' stay quiet
fire: The fines are a state-imposed limit on sales of fuel.
Workers dug a man-made canal across the plain.
He kept to a strict self-imposed schedule all winter.
Experts blame manmade emissions for most of the warming.
These tariffs are court-imposed and cannot be appealed.
The shop sells home-made soap and candles.
Her self-imposed exile lasted for a decade.
Divers explored a man-made reef near the harbor.
quiet: The fines are a strict limit on sales of fuel.
Workers dug a shallow canal across the plain.
He kept to a strict daily schedule all winter.
Experts blame volcanic emissions for most of the cooling.
These tariffs are very high and cannot be appealed.
The shop sells lavender soap and candles.
Her long exile lasted for a decade.
They made a raft and sailed near the harbor.
